resources.string: Soon you can dress the bear and decorate the home here
Strong black tea with mint and sugar, poured into a tiny glass. The aroma spreads at once.
Sizzling bacon, a runny fried egg and toasted bread — the classic American power breakfast.
A chewy bagel slathered with cream cheese, plus a cup of coffee. The rhythm of the city.
Kimchi, radish, spinach and more in little dishes across the table — a colorful morning ritual.
A crisp baguette stuffed with grilled pork, cilantro and pickled radish. Sour, spicy and refreshing.
Puffy white steamed buns with savory, juicy filling inside. Warm in your hand, warmer in your tummy.
Crunchy grains in cold milk with fruit slices. A little bowl of childlike joy.
Thin steamed rice rolls wrapped around shrimp and greens, finished with a spoon of soy sauce.
Slow-simmered rice porridge with pickles and pork floss. Light, gentle and easy on the stomach.
Honey-sweet dates are nature\'s candy from the desert. Perfect with a cup of tea.
Golden toast topped with a soft-boiled egg. Poke it gently and the yolk flows onto the bread.
Fried egg, sausage, bacon, grilled tomato and baked beans on one plate — a feast-like ritual.
Golden chickpea fritters, crispy outside and tender inside, dipped in tahini. A street-food favorite.
Bread soaked in egg and milk, pan-fried golden and dusted with sugar. Crispy outside, pudding inside.
Steaming hot rice topped with a raw egg yolk and sesame oil. Simple, yet impossible to stop eating.
Silky hummus drizzled with olive oil, scooped up with warm pita. Fragrant and filling.
A thin mung bean crepe, an egg, sauce and a crispy youtiao inside — best eaten on the way to work.
Thick, glutinous rice porridge topped with seaweed and sesame, a drop of sesame oil warming you right up.
Crispy toast filled with green kaya jam and cold butter, with a cup of Nanyang coffee. Sweet mornings.
Seaweed rolls packed with rice, egg strips, carrot and ham, sliced into rounds. The picnic essential.
A thick toast sandwich with fried egg and cabbage, brushed with sweet-savory sauce. Street mornings at their best.
Flatbread topped with sesame and herbs, baked until the edges turn crispy. Roll it up and go.
Soft, pull-apart milk bread with a glass of warm milk. Simple and comforting.
Coconut-scented rice with fried peanuts, anchovies and sambal. The way a tropical morning begins.
A clear broth with noodles and a poached egg, sprinkled with scallions. One big slurp and you are set.
Oats cooked in milk with blueberries and chopped nuts. A soft, energizing start.
A fluffy egg wrap hiding cheese and bell peppers. Cut it open and watch the steam rise.
Clear beef broth poured over silky noodles and thin beef slices, finished with lime. Unbelievably fresh.
Flaky, layered flatbread torn by hand and dipped in curry. Warm and fragrant.
Ham, lettuce and fried egg stacked between bread slices — a proper breakfast even when in a hurry.
Soft eggs bubbling in a tomato sauce, mopped up with bread. Sour, sweet and appetizing.
Golden waffles with maple syrup and berries piled on top. Sweet enough to start any day.
Golden, crispy fried dough sticks with a bowl of hot soy milk — the most satisfying crunch of the morning.
A crispy golden rice pancake stuffed with beansprouts and shrimp, wrapped in lettuce with fish sauce. Crunch!
A sizzling grill with smoke and meat aroma — the taste of summer nights.
Spam, sausage, ramen and cheese in one big bubbling pot. The louder it simmers, the better.
Golden crispy fried chicken with an ice-cold beer. The formula for happiness in every drama.
Fluffy steamed semolina with stew and gravy. The homey taste of North Africa.
Sweet-savory short ribs grilled to a char, wrapped in lettuce. Juice bursting in your mouth.
Silky poached chicken with fragrant chicken-oil rice and ginger dip. Simple yet unforgettable.
A bubbling spicy broth with endless meat and vegetables. Joy of the shared pot.
Antipasti, pasta and dessert arriving course by course. A leisurely evening in the south.
Thick black bean sauce coating chewy noodles with onion and pork. Slurp it up.
Large chunks of meat grilled to a char over charcoal, with onion and yogurt sauce. Bold and hearty.
Coconut curry broth over rice noodles, piled with shrimp and fish cake. Rich and addictive.
A ring grill that braises and roasts at once, meat and greens sizzling on both sides. Everyone gathers round.
Saffron rice layered with braised lamb, finished with yogurt sauce. A grand dish for guests.
Gently sweet curry with beef, potato and peanuts. Mild, not spicy, and full of fragrance.
Colorful small plates across the table, dips and bread, eaten while chatting the night away.
Cheese stretching into long ribbons, edges baked crispy. One slice leads to another.
Thin slices of meat and vegetables swished in a light broth, dipped in sesame sauce. Warm and gentle.
Rotating grilled meat with lettuce and garlic sauce. Rich, fragrant, and keeps you coming back.
A scalding stone pot of soft tofu stew, silky and melting, even fresher with an egg dropped in.
Tomato meat sauce clinging to every strand, twirled and lifted. Rich and satisfying.
A steak sizzling on the hot plate, sliced open to a beautiful pink. Just right with red wine.
A lavish seafood platter where the sweetness of fresh fish melts on your tongue.
Lamb and vegetables slow-cooked under a cone lid, spices fully soaked in. A burst of aroma when opened.
Rice, miso soup, a main and sides in neat sections. Even dining alone feels ceremonial.
Charcoal-grilled chicken skewers brushed with sauce, paired with beer. Late-night diner classic.
Rice, mains and sides arranged neatly in sections. Opening the lid is like unwrapping a gift.
A sizzling stone pot, egg, gochujang and vegetables stirred into the rice. The crispy bottom is the best.
A soft bun, a juicy beef patty, melted cheese and lettuce. One giant bite of happiness.
A burger with freshly fried fries and ketchup — the classic double happiness.
Golden chickpea fritters with salad and tahini, wrapped in pita. Vegetarian food with real character.
Crispy toasted pita chips tossed with tomatoes, cucumber and a tangy dressing. Fresh and bright.
Grains of rice tossed over high heat with egg, full of wok aroma. The taste of home.
Rich coconut green curry with rice or baguette. Mildly spicy, gently warm.
Plump dumplings with thin skins and generous filling, dipped in vinegar and chili oil.
Saffron rice with large pieces of grilled meat, spices soaking into every grain. A feast for guests.
Sliced pork sizzling on the grill, wrapped in lettuce with dipping sauce. Meat heaven.
Charcoal-grilled skewers sizzling with cumin and chili. One after another.
Sour, spicy kimchi stew bubbling away with a bowl of hot rice. Simple and appetizing.
Hummus, eggplant dip, olives and pita covering the table. Best shared with friends.
Wok-fried rice with a fried egg and prawn crackers, topped with fried shallots. The whole table gets hungry.
Glossy rice noodles with lime and crushed peanuts — sweet, sour, salty and fresh all at once.
Sunshine and grass, sandwiches, fruit and sparkling water on a checkered cloth. Lunch like a holiday.
Brown rice topped with salmon, avocado and corn, drizzled with sauce. Fresh and light.
Rich broth with springy noodles and a soft-boiled egg. One slurp, one giant bowl.
Noodles soaking up a fiery broth, topped with cheese and an egg. Late-night comfort.
Grilled skewers brushed with peanut sauce, sweet and savory, with cucumber on the side.
Slices carved from a rotating spit, wrapped in bread with garlic sauce and pickles. The aroma is unreal.
Rice vinegar seasoned just right, topped with fresh fish. Little bites of elegance.
The workday savior. The moment the warm box opens, the whole desk smells amazing.
Sour, spicy shrimp soup with lemongrass and lime leaves. One sip wakes you right up.
Chewy rice cakes coated in sweet-spicy sauce, with fish cake and egg. Street-side royalty.
